zh.title: Lincoln Airport（LNK）主跑道重建 鋪設17英吋混凝土
zh.summary: Lincoln Airport重建主跑道，跑道鋪設17英吋混凝土
body: Simple Flying報導，Lincoln Airport（LNK）目前正進行主跑道重大重建。報導標題指出，機場正於一條為B-47轟炸機建造的跑道上澆置17英吋混凝土。
報導摘要稱，Lincoln Airport曾是冷戰時期基地，目前是八架KC-135R加油機的駐地。摘要並指出，該機場的主跑道正進行重大重建；標題所述的混凝土施工則涉及一條為B-47轟炸機建造的跑道。

en.title: Lincoln Airport (LNK) Pours 17 Inches of Concrete as Primary Runway Is Rebuilt
en.summary: Lincoln Airport rebuilds its primary runway with 17 inches of concrete over a runway built for B-47 bombers.
body: Simple Flying reports that Lincoln Airport (LNK) is undergoing a major reconstruction of its primary runway. The publication’s headline says the airport is pouring 17 inches of concrete over a runway built for B-47 bombers.

The report’s summary describes Lincoln Airport as a former Cold War base and says it is now home to eight KC-135R tankers. It also identifies the primary runway as undergoing major reconstruction. The headline describes concrete being poured over a runway built for B-47 bombers.
